text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I had so much fun making videos last night...
that I ended up going to bed super late~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I wanna tweak the cuts and colors a bit more to make it super flashy, ya know~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll keep going once I'm home...
*yaaawn*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo got so carried away with her hobby
that she didn't seem to get much rest...
